claim: react-i18next supports ICU inline syntax via the i18next-icu plugin, not natively; ICU consolidates plural cases into one string vs suffixed keys.
quote: i18next itself is flexible enough to support multiple existing i18next formats beside its own. So also the ICU format, thanks to i18next-icu.

claim: i18next-icu is the plugin adding ICU MessageFormat support to i18next.
quote: i18nFormat plugin to use ICU format with i18next

claim: i18next v4 uses CLDR-named suffixed keys (key_one, key_few, key_many, key_other) resolved via Intl.PluralRules; tradeoffs vs ICU inline plural syntax.
quote: v4 switched from numeric suffixes...to the CLDR category names (key_one, key_two, key_few, key_many, key_other), powered by Intl.PluralRules.

claim: FormatJS intl-messageformat supports plural, select, selectordinal and ICU number/date skeletons (::currency/EUR), formatting via Intl.NumberFormat/DateTimeFormat/PluralRules.
quote: Supports plural, select, and selectordinal message arguments ... Formats numbers and dates/times in messages using Intl.NumberFormat and Intl.DateTimeFormat

claim: react-intl is part of FormatJS and formats strings/numbers/dates/plurals using ICU MessageFormat natively.
quote: React Intl ... provides React components and hooks for formatting strings, numbers, dates, and plurals using the ICU MessageFormat standard.

claim: Lingui macros (t, plural, select, selectOrdinal, Trans) transform at build time into ICU MessageFormat messages.
quote: The t macro transforms tagged template literal into message in ICU MessageFormat.

claim: Lingui uses ICU MessageFormat as its standard runtime syntax, supporting plural, select, selectordinal with =0 exact matches and offsets.
quote: Lingui uses ICU MessageFormat ... a flexible and powerful syntax designed to express the grammatical nuances of different languages.

claim: Lingui i18n.number() and i18n.date() pass options to Intl.NumberFormat/DateTimeFormat for locale-aware number, currency and date formatting.
quote: i18n.number(12345.678, { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }) returns '$12,345.68'

claim: next-intl supports ICU plural, selectordinal, select and rich-text (t.rich) natively via curly-brace messages; uses Intl.PluralRules.
quote: You have {count, plural, =0 {no followers yet} =1 {one follower} other {# followers}}.

claim: next-intl wraps FormatJS and supports ICU number skeletons like ::currency/USD and ::percent inline in messages.
quote: {p, number, ::currency/USD} renders currency with the right symbol and separators for the current locale while keeping USD.

claim: Paraglide models plurals/gender as variants with declared selectors; message format is plugin-based and can use ICU via the ICU plugin.
quote: Variants enable pluralization, gendering, A/B testing, and more ... prefer the familiar ICU MessageFormat syntax via the ICU plugin

claim: Paraglide built-in formatters plural/number/datetime/relativetime map to Intl.PluralRules/NumberFormat/DateTimeFormat/RelativeTimeFormat.
quote: Built-in formatter names: plural (uses Intl.PluralRules) number (uses Intl.NumberFormat) datetime (uses Intl.DateTimeFormat) relativetime (uses Intl.RelativeTimeFormat)

claim: The default inlang message format is not ICU natively; its syntax is inspired by the MessageFormat 2.0 draft and uses declaration/selector/match variants.
quote: its syntax is inspired by the upcoming MessageFormat 2.0 draft ... The format is not ICU MessageFormat natively.

claim: typesafe-i18n uses a custom (non-ICU) syntax with pipe formatters over Intl and Intl.PluralRules, prioritising full TypeScript type-safety.
quote: A fully type-safe and lightweight internationalization library ... allows formatting of values e.g. locale-dependent date or number formats

claim: typesafe-i18n plural shorthand uses {{sing|plur}} via Intl.PluralRules; combining formatters inside plural branches needs a custom plural-aware formatter workaround.
quote: I have {{zero|one|two|a few|many|a lot}} apple{{s}}

claim: i18next formatting delegates to the Intl API (Intl.NumberFormat, Intl.DateTimeFormat) with the active language, caching formatter instances.
quote: i18next passes the active language to the right Intl API ... calling the matching Intl API (Intl.NumberFormat, Intl.DateTimeFormat, etc.)

claim: ICU MessageFormat is the de facto industry standard for plurals/select/formatting that TMS tools parse and validate in 2026.
quote: ICU Message Format Guide: Syntax, Plurals & Real-World Examples (2026)

claim: Plural categories vary by language: Japanese only 'other', Arabic uses all six; ICU handles this range in one string.
quote: Some languages like Japanese have only 'other', while Arabic uses all 6 categories for plural forms.

claim: ICU MessageFormat is the format professional localization tooling understands, favouring it for external-translator workflows.
quote: A Practical Guide to the ICU Message Format

claim: react-intl uses ICU natively while react-i18next is interpolation-first with optional ICU; comparison of syntax and bundle size in 2026.
quote: react-i18next vs react-intl 2026: Syntax, ICU, Bundle Size

claim: Paraglide JS is a compiler-based i18n library emitting tree-shakable translation functions.
quote: Compiler-based i18n library that emits tree-shakable translations, leading to up to 70% smaller bundle sizes.
